_doc: Connection registry for the personal OS (roadmap: CONNECTIONS.md). One row per external connection: what it is, where its credential lives BY NAME ONLY (never a value), how conn_check.py proves it alive, and how it is renewed. `check.type` is one of: imap, ics, status_file, env, cmd, cmd_output, cmd_match (output regexes `live` / `missing`), http, mcp, meta_ads, json_fields, manual. `owner` says who can renew it: the owner (a password, an OAuth click, a sign-in) or claude. States written to data/connections_status.json: live, dead, not_configured, manual. Add a row here in the same change that adds a connection (plus boundary.json and the gate baseline when it can send). Optional `setup` block = the button on Mission Control's Setup page (scripts/setup_actions.py): kind terminal|env|window|signin|open_url|mcp|text, with label/argv/url/name/also_url/how; without one the recipe is derived from the check type and the renew text.

chat._doc: Chat setup (assistant/scripts/connect.py, 2026-10-16): the owner says one of ask_words and gets these steps with links in chat; a message holding something that matches `paste` is claimed by code, stored, and scrubbed from the chat record. No model turn anywhere in this flow.
chat._defer_doc: A general bank ask that never says SimpleFIN gets defer_to's steps instead (Relay via Plaid, the business bank) while either bank feed is not working, plus one line pointing back here (the owner 2026-10-17: the Relay feed was the one down and he got only SimpleFIN steps).
steps: Open https://beta-bridge.simplefin.org/ and create an account (about $15 a year).
Tap Connect a bank and sign in to each bank or card you want tracked. Your logins stay with SimpleFIN; nothing is typed here. Relay is not on SimpleFIN, that one is a separate Plaid step.
Back on the SimpleFIN main page tap New App (or Setup Token) and copy the token, a long block of letters.
Paste the token here as its own message. I will claim it, store it read-only on the PC, remove it from this chat record, and pull your accounts.

connections.credential: Credential Manager owner1-assistant / plaid:client_id + plaid:secret (from dashboard.plaid.com) and plaid:access_token:<item> written by the Link flow; the Relay login is typed only inside Plaid's own Link window
connections.renew: python assistant/scripts/money/plaid.py setup   (re-link; add --update <item_id> after an ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED error)

setup.label: Enter keys + link Relay (PC console)
setup.how: Easiest: tap 'Connect from this phone' (or say 'set up Plaid' in chat): a three-step page creates the Plaid account (your sign-up; skipped once keys are stored), takes the two keys straight into the PC's Credential Manager, and opens Plaid Link right there so you sign in to Relay inside Plaid's window, then again for each other bank (Connect another bank). The console button does the same from the PC.

chat._doc: Chat setup (assistant/scripts/connect.py, 2026-10-16): the owner says one of ask_words and gets these steps in chat. Plaid's keys are long-lived secrets, so there is NO paste block: they are typed on the /setup/plaid page (the owner's own PC answering over the tailnet), never in chat. {mc_url} is filled in from Mission Control's address.
steps: On your phone, open {mc_url}/setup/plaid (the same place as your cards). Everything below is a tap on that page or in your phone's browser; nothing is opened or run on the PC.

steps.text: Tap Open Plaid sign-up and make your Plaid account with your own email (free tier, a couple of screens). Then tap Open Keys page (https://dashboard.plaid.com/developers/keys) and tap the copy icon next to client_id.

Back on the page, tap Paste to paste the client id. Then on the Keys page tap the eye next to the production secret, copy it, and tap Paste by the secret box. Tap Store and verify: they go straight into the PC's Credential Manager; I never see them in chat.
Your Plaid account and keys are already stored in the PC's Credential Manager, so the page opens straight at Connect.
Tap Connect Relay. Plaid's own window opens right there on your phone; sign in to Relay inside it and pick Operating, Tax and Savings.

steps: Then tap Connect another bank for each other bank or card you want on the feed; Plaid's window opens again each time. Repeat until every bank is listed on the page.
I pull the first year of transactions for each bank and tell you here what I can see. Read-only: I cannot move money.

Every step works from your phone, nothing needs the PC. A bank that signs you in on its own site (Chase, Amex, Capital One...) sends you back to the page by itself once the page's address is allowed in Plaid: the page gives you a Copy address button and an Open API page link for that one-time tap. If a bank needs you to sign in again, tap Re-sign-in on the page.
